rows.theirWords: No users exist with that email.
rows.source: Zapier's own password-reset page, asked for erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com after the deletion
rows.story: Zapier answered our letter: delete the account yourself first. Its delete page then asked for a fresh password check that looped back to Google sign-in. We set a password from Zapier's own reset email, passed the check and deleted the account. Zapier Support then wrote back: "I've verified that your account has been successfully removed", and started erasing the rest from its systems, backups and marketing lists.

rows.theirWords: Sorry, we didn't recognize that email.
rows.source: Medium's own sign-in page, for the address that signed up with Google on 19 Nov 2026 (Google's sign-in notice is in the demo inbox)
rows.story: Medium answered our letter on 23 Nov with steps to delete it ourselves. Four days later its sign-in page recognises neither the Google sign-in nor the email address.
rows.check: Open medium.com/m/signin, choose Sign in with email and enter erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com.

rows.theirWords: I can confirm that your Asana account associated with erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com has now been deleted.
rows.source: Asana Support, replying to our request ER-6J752
rows.story: Two and a half days after one email. Erased read the reply on the device and marked the request confirmed.
rows.check: The full reply is on the live run under Asana.

rows.theirWords: We have taken action per your request.
rows.source: Skillshare's Privacy Team (privacy-requests@skillshare.com), email "Privacy Request / skillshare.com results" to the demo inbox about its Deletion request
rows.story: Skillshare answered our email by pointing to a privacy form behind a captcha. We filled the form under Nigeria's NDPA, a person cleared the captcha, and the identity check was answered five minutes later. Skillshare confirmed receipt at 22:03 UTC and wrote that it had taken action two hours later, about five hours after the form.
rows.check: Both Skillshare emails are in the demo inbox; its first reply, pointing to the form, is on the live run under Skillshare.

rows.theirWords: We've deactivated your account, you will no longer be able to log into your account.
rows.source: Wix Customer Care (notifications-support@wix.com), replying to our request, ref 060526038
rows.story: Same morning as our email. In its other reply Wix wrote that the data from all its services is deleted 7 days later and cannot be reverted, and that its support will no longer recognise the account.
rows.check: Wix's replies are on the live run under Wix, including a later one confirming that the account is deactivated and its data deletion has begun.

rows.source: Grammarly's own page, grammarly.com/account-deleted, after deleting the account signed in as erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com
rows.story: Grammarly answered our letter by taking the address off its mailing list and saying the account itself must be deleted by us, from its profile page. Erased named that step. We signed in with Google, pressed Delete Account and confirmed. The whole run is on video.
rows.check: Watch the 36-second screen recording of the deletion.

rows.source: Airtable's own sign-in page, asked for erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com after the deletion: it answers "Signing up as erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com" and asks for a new name and password
rows.story: Airtable answered our letter by deleting the address from its sales and marketing systems and saying the account itself must be deleted by us. Erased named that step. We signed in, pressed Delete your Airtable user account and confirmed. A 20-second recording shows it; Airtable's sign-in page now treats the address as new.
rows.check: Open airtable.com/login, enter erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com and press Continue. The deletion itself is in a 20-second recording on the release.

rows.source: monday.com's own sign-in page, asked for erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com, which had a monday.com account and got its emails
rows.story: monday.com's privacy team asked us to prove the request was ours. Erased wrote the answer, and on 26 Nov the team replied that our request was in progress. Two days later its sign-in page no longer finds the address and offers a new sign-up.
rows.check: Open auth.monday.com/auth/login_monday, enter erased.demo.inbox@gmail.com and press Next.
